//: Shared type-checking bar for every plugin in plugins/dist/.
The root tsconfig.json excludes `plugins`, and esbuild strips types without
checking them, so plugin sources went unchecked entirely until this existed.
Each plugin extends this and exposes a `typecheck` script; build-plugins.ts
runs it before building, so a type error fails the build instead of shipping.
target/lib track the esbuild output target (node18+), not the root's ES2017 —
plugins legitimately use ES2018+ features such as `for await`.
compilerOptions only: TypeScript resolves `include`/`exclude` relative to the
file that declares them, so putting them here would point every plugin at
plugins/*.ts. Each plugin declares its own.
useDefineForClassFields is pinned false on purpose. esbuild auto-discovers
tsconfig.json and honors it, so simply adding these configs flipped class
fields from assignment to Object.defineProperty semantics and rewrote nine
bundles. Adding a typecheck must not change what ships.
